The greeting, the sentence offering a 30-minute live demo with the calendar link, the sign-off, the signature and the opt-out line are fixed text added by code: do not write them.

Language: {{ ['turkey','türkiye','turkiye'].includes(String($('Loop Over Follow-ups').item.json.Country || '').trim().toLowerCase()) ? 'Turkish (natural business Turkish, not a translation)' : 'English' }}.
Audience: {{ /^(marka|brand)$/i.test(String($('Loop Over Follow-ups').item.json.Segment || '').trim()) ? 'a BRAND that is legally accountable for supplier data (passport, due diligence, EPR)' : 'an EXPORTER / MANUFACTURER whose EU customers ask for Digital Product Passport and compliance data' }}.
Core message: {{ /^(marka|brand)$/i.test(String($('Loop Over Follow-ups').item.json.Segment || '').trim()) ? ($('Read Settings (mail)').first().json['Value Prop Brand EN'] || '') : ($('Read Settings (mail)').first().json['Value Prop Exporter EN'] || '') }}

One short paragraph, max 60 words, no greeting, no sign-off, no link.
Follow-up 2: one useful angle from the approved messages below that a short reminder can carry.
Follow-up 3: a polite last note: say briefly that this is your last message on the subject and that the offer stays open.

Approved messages (use only these, lightly rephrased; add no other claims):
- Exporters: the same certificate, report and audit data is prepared again for every customer today; in Texprove it is organised once and reused for every customer. You do not start from scratch: you import your existing data and can export it any time; your data stays yours. Your ERP does not change; you connect by Excel or API. You do not have to open up your supplier network.
- Brands: one verified source instead of email and Excel. A document and an auditor's approval behind every claim. Suppliers share the evidence without opening up their network; joining is free for suppliers.
- Both: Texprove is a GS1 Türkiye solution partner.
- Dates, only these: the EU forced labour ban applies from 14 December 2027; the textile Digital Product Passport rules are expected in 2027 (never a fixed date); textile EPR national schemes are due by April 2028 (the obligation sits with the brand that places the product on the EU market; to an exporter say "for your customer, the brand").

Never write: prices, package names, percentages or savings rates, "fewer audits", Tier claims, catalog, sample, video, a call or meeting, any link, competitor figures, any other date. Never mention the company's customers, buyers or the brands it supplies by name, nor order volumes, quantities, capacities, margins or revenue.{{ $('Decide Follow-up Action').item.json.fu_edit_notes ? parameters.content:
## Follow-ups (with Nil's approval)
Daily: for up to 15 due leads (Stage Sent / Follow-up 1 / Follow-up 2, Next Follow-up Date reached, not on the Suppression tab, no reply in the Gmail thread):
- No draft yet, or Approved = Edit: the model writes the follow-up, "Check Follow-up" screens it (buyers, money, quantities, hype), and the clean text goes to the Leads column "Follow-up Draft" with Approved = Pending. Blocked text goes to the Log tab and is retried next run.
- Approved = Yes: the draft is sent in the original Gmail thread, logged in HubSpot, the next follow-up is scheduled (+10 / +20 days from Sent At) and the draft column is cleared.
- Approved = No: draft cleared, no further follow-up scheduled.
- Approved = Pending: wait.
After the loop, Nil gets one summary (email, WhatsApp, Telegram). Separately closes leads still on Follow-up 3 with no reply for 7 days. Everything is appended to the Log tab.
